assumptions.source_format: actual existing v5 bytes; untouched fields are not repacked
assumptions.repeat: one flag per selected later field; changed fields retain full absolute width
assumptions.rice: zigzag delta q<8 costs q+1+k; q>=8 is eight zero bits then full absolute field
assumptions.history: reset only per segment; update every stored tuple, including unused lag and tail
assumptions.alignment: continuous LSB packing within segment, exact independent final byte padding
assumptions.nomination: tuning baseline and expanded100 only; positive aggregate savings in both, minimum repeat field count then best worst-source fractional saving; best Rice is separate higher-complexity point
assumptions.fallback: optional per-segment min(v5,new) is a data-only envelope; dual decoder cost is not free
assumptions.flash: saved complete stream bytes are optimistic added-decoder/table/layout allowance only; no linked firmware saving is measured
assumptions.quality: no STOI, music quality, perceived gain or implemented new-decoder exactness claim

nomination.rule: tuning baseline and expanded100 only; positive aggregate savings in both, minimum repeat field count then best worst-source fractional saving; best Rice is separate higher-complexity point

scope: Exact hypothetical complete bytes under declared syntax/header/padding only. All actual nonparameter bits retained. Data savings are optimistic per-image allowances for new decoder/table/layout cost; aggregate corpus totals are not a single firmware budget.
